blocks.text: Pesticides aise kimiyai maddey hain jo keeron, jari-bootiyon (weeds) ya phaphoond (fungi) jaise nuqsan-deh jandaron ko maarne ya qaboo karne mein use hote hain. Yeh fasalon ko nuqsan se bachate, khurak ka zayaa rokte aur mustahkam khurak ki farahmi mein madad dete hain. Inhein hadaf ke lihaz se insecticides, herbicides aur fungicides mein taqseem kiya jata hai.

blocks.caption: Pesticides ki qismein (matan se)
rows: Keere ke nizam-e-asaab par neurotoxins ka kaam, falij aur maut
Kuch enzymes rok kar zaruri amino acids banne nahi detin; kuch electron transport bigar kar photosynthesis rok deti hain
Cell ki salamati par hamla; maslan ergosterol ki tayyari rokti hain, jis se phaphoond ki jhilli risti aur cell mar jata

blocks.title: Zinc phosphide fungicide nahi
blocks.text: Kitab zinc phosphide ko aam fungicides mein ginti hai; yeh chuhe maar dawa (rodenticide) ke taur par use hota hai. Neez sirf kuch fungicides (jaise triazoles) ergosterol ki tayyari par asar karte hain; strobilurins is ke bajaye phaphoond ke cells mein tawanai ki paidawar rokte hain. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

Pesticides jadeed khurak ke programmes mein kaleedi kirdar ada karte hain. Yeh paudon ko keeron aur bimariyon se bacha kar paidawar barhate, wabaon ka khatra kam kar ke insani sehat behtar karte, aur duniya bhar mein khurak ki hifazat (food security) mein hissa dalte hain. Lekin yeh carcinogenic aur neurotoxic ho kar sehat ko nuqsan bhi de sakte hain. Mufeed keere, parinde aur aabi jandaar mutasir ho sakte hain; kheton se behta pani aabi zakhire aaloodah kar sakta hai; aur ghair-hadaf jandaar jaise phool bar-awar karne wali madhu-makhiyan nuqsan utha sakti hain (neonicotinoids ka talluq madhu-makhiyon ke 'colony collapse disorder' se bataya gaya hai). Waqt ke saath keere kisi pesticide ke khilaf mazahmat paida kar lete hain, jis se zyada zehreele pesticides use karne parte hain jin ke mazeed mahol aur sehat ke khatre hain.

blocks.prompt: Pesticides ke istemal ka aik faida aur aik khatra batayein.
blocks.explanation: Faida: fasalon ko bachate aur paidawar barhate (food security). Khatra: maslan madhu-makhiyon jaise ghair-hadaf jandaron ko nuqsan, pani ki aaloodgi, ya mazahmati keere.

items: Insecticides: nizam-e-asaab; herbicides: amino acids ya photosynthesis; fungicides: cell ki jhilli.
Faide: paidawar, food security; khatre: sehat, madhu-makhiyan, pani, mazahmat.
